en.engine.notes.movement: If you already move for longer, keep your own number: it’s never lowered.

en.engine.notes.strengthStop: Stop and get medical help if you have chest pain, feel faint, or are much more out of breath than usual.
en.engine.notes.strengthJoint: Keep to what your physiotherapist or clinician has advised.
en.engine.notes.strengthTeen: Learn technique from a qualified coach or PE teacher first, build up gradually, avoid maximal lifts, and stop if anything hurts.
en.engine.notes.strengthOlder: A professional can also suggest balance and strength activities that suit you.
en.engine.notes.strengthRecovery: Rest days help you recover. Did you train different muscles?
